summary: ADR-0060 accepted 2026-08-18; v1 Skill-input remains historical compatibility and cannot auto-promote to v2 authority; v2 assigns each candidate exactly one role: normative_source, authority_source, implementation_input, lifecycle_projection, derived_context, execution_evidence, report, ephemeral_attempt; only first three authorize; v2 separates sourceSelectionHash from sourceContentHash, binding roles/relative paths/modules/scope/resources versus selected bytes; adapter owns transport/page ranges/continuation/coverage/truncation and complete coverage prevents lossy-summary truncation; ready receipts are immutable generations under skill-input-generations/<binding-hash>/; validated non-authorizing current pointer advances atomically, consumers resolve pointer only; execution, publication, semantic-review gates independent; Knowledge self-change derived from changed-set and canonical path policy, never caller flag; attempts require leases/heartbeats; retention protects pointer, lifecycle/authorization/terminal references, active attempts; committed evidence deletion needs maintainer approval plus non-authorizing cleanup receipt; migrate all consumers before 8-18 creates new current receipt; existing skill-input-current* remain immutable historical evidence; ADR does not create lifecycle authority, publish Knowledge, or start Bootstrap; extends ADR-0048/0050/0057/0058/0059 and supersedes only their v1 selection/current-resolution practices
